finding_status.notes: setting_id=request.setting_id added to the create route; asserted by test_create_route_forwards_setting_id_to_credential_resolution, and re-verified live (the wrong-URL integration now fails while the correct one returns 8).
setting_id=payload.index_info.setting_id added to reindex_xwiki; asserted by test_scheduled_reindex_uses_the_datasource_integration.

_get now retries once on timeout, 429 and 5xx and never on 4xx/401/403. Six tests cover the retry, the recovery, and the no-retry cases. The confirmation pass noted no Retry-After backoff; deferred, the spec asked for a bounded retry, not backoff.
The PUT raises 404 when kb_index.xwiki is absent, before any dereference; asserted by test_update_route_rejects_a_datasource_of_another_type including ordering.
xwiki_index_info is Optional with default None; test asserts the field is not required.
Processor is built with new_project_name or project_name; asserted by test_update_route_reindexes_under_the_new_project_name.
The use_bearer branch is gone and _auth_headers documents why Basic is the only path; the test now pins that use_bearer=True still yields Basic.
lazy_load no longer clears _truncated, and fetch_remote_stats assigns it in both branches so a reused instance cannot carry a stale True. Two tests cover both directions.
The collision test now uses distinct fixtures and asserts two distinct source values and two distinct spaces.

Budget denominator is the total from fetch_remote_stats mid-crawl, re-checked against pages actually walked at end of crawl, plus an all-failed guard. Three tests, including the case the confirmation pass raised (stats total far larger than the crawl).

Resolved as a documented decision rather than code: no https gate, because xWiki is typically self-hosted where http is normal. _auth_headers and spec section 9 now state the cleartext exposure, and the MR raises on-prem transport policy as an open question for the core team.
